title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks | TechCrunch
summary: For starters, it’s splitting up Device Control and Data Access into two settings: System & App Protection Override and Accessibility. Similar guidance will appear when users enable Full Disk Access to allow an app to access their folders.
